rules: Binary case counts and case fraction are condition-specific, not universal or equivalent to population prevalence.
Unknown and not-applicable fields do not become zero or invented estimates.
Raw phased genotypes and calculated/public LD matrices are separate products.
Dependencies specify interpretation/validation inputs; they do not grant access or impose a raw-download sequence.

limitations: This is source documentation and catalog consistency work, not artifact validation, genetic inference or clinical prediction.
